source: Markers: snapshot of the tarkov.dev maps data (API format), fetched 2026-09-23T07:13:13Z, via a public mirror — refresh with scripts/fetch_data.py against the live API when it is reachable. Transform, bounds, floor extents and labels: the-hideout/tarkov-dev src/data/maps.json. Basemap: the-hideout/tarkov-dev-svg-maps Interchange.svg. Community data, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

markers.name: Railway Exfil
markers.note: Open extract at the railway terminus, north-west corner of the map. Scav extract.

markers.name: Saferoom Exfil
markers.note: Conditional extract. Needs the power switch on (Power Station), the flush lever in the Burger Spot restroom on Mall Floor 2, and an Object #11SR keycard swiped at the Saferoom door. Single use — the keycard is consumed. PMC extract.

markers.name: Railway Exfil
markers.note: Open extract at the railway terminus, north-west corner of the map. PMC extract.

markers.name: Emercom Checkpoint
markers.note: Open extract at the Emercom checkpoint, south-east highway corner. Shared extract.

markers.name: Scav Camp (Co-Op)
markers.note: Co-op extract. A PMC and a Scav must be in the extract zone at the same time for it to work. Shared extract.

markers.name: Path to River (Flare)
markers.note: Flare extract. Fire a signal flare while standing in the marked zone to open the extract, then leave before the timer runs out. PMC extract.

markers.name: Power Station V-Ex
markers.note: Vehicle extract. Pay the driver in roubles; the car leaves when its timer ends and it can only be used once per raid. PMC extract.

markers.name: Smugglers' Tunnel
markers.note: Extract in the service tunnel beneath the mall — reach it from the parking garage level. PMC extract.

markers.name: Hole in the Fence
markers.note: No backpack allowed. Drop your backpack before stepping in — you cannot extract while wearing one. PMC extract.
